name: JavaScript Memory Model
description: The memory model of JavaScript, based on the C11 model. Like C11 it suffers from the thin-air problem and so provides only the internal DRF guarantee, but — unlike C11 — it does not treat racy non-atomic accesses as undefined behaviour. Because its main shared primitive is the SharedArrayBuffer, a linear mutable byte buffer, the model naturally supports mixed-size accesses. It was repaired and mechanised by Watt et al.

catSupport.note: A C11-shaped axiomatic model (mechanised by Watt et al.): per-execution axioms over mixed-size accesses, which cat's mixed-size support (cf. x86tso-mixed.cat) already handles. No cat model has been published.
